baselines.name: same-packet no-regroup warp match and exact all-pairs candidate comparison

costs.scope: device-resident sort/gather/match/scatter with preallocated scratch; packet formation, allocation and transfers excluded

quality.probe: controlled cross-warp placement, exact partner recall and collision/source-identity accounting on an upper-bound distant-source packet

limitations: oracle-assembled distant-source packet is an upper-bound fixture, not deployed candidate routing
sorted equal-key group spans warp boundary and loses 120 of 994 directed partner relations
CUB regrouping is slower than no-regroup and all-pairs for the fixed 128-candidate packet
equal keys do not establish biological identity or useful interaction
no complete packet formation, H2D/D2H or arbitrary nonlocal movement cost
conclusion: Do not promote online CUB regrouping from this fixture: it is slower and loses defined-key partners at warp boundaries; retain source-preserving bounded tests only.
